{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "ipc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Modifies signatures in src/interfaces/chain.h, src/interfaces/node.h, and src/interfaces/wallet.h, but interface mechanics are not the point.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The category definition excludes wallet PRs that modify `interfaces::Wallet` unless interface mechanics (such as IPC protocol or capnp serialization) are the point."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/net_processing.cpp and src/net_processing.h only to adapt to the modified BroadcastTransaction signature.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The edits in net_processing are mechanical adaptations following from the transaction broadcast signature refactoring rather than changes to P2P relay or protocol behavior."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/rpc/mempool.cpp and src/rpc/util.cpp to accommodate the updated broadcast error type.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Existing RPC behavior is explicitly preserved by discarding the returned error, making the changes in RPC files purely mechanical call-site updates."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/test/fuzz/kitchen_sink.cpp (+1/-0) solely to adapt a test caller to the new return type.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "The change does not touch test runners or shared test infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/common/messages.cpp and introduces TransactionBroadcastError in node types.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "TransactionBroadcastError is a domain-specific node and wallet transaction error type, not general-purpose shared infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Has Wallet label and modifies CWallet::CommitTransaction() in src/wallet/wallet.cpp and src/wallet/wallet.h along with wallet unit tests.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "It fixes a noticeable reliability bug where frontends falsely report success when the node rejects a transaction. The PR description notes that 'The QML GUI shows \"Transaction sent\" even when the node rejected the transaction, because CWallet::CommitTransaction() only logs the rejection and returns void', and propagating errors resolves this while unblocking gui-qml#1008."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {

  }
